messages:
maria: Heads-up: Solara Health POC kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. They need Private deployment reachable from their VPCs. Main asks: preferred connectivity patterns, egress IP stability, and a one-page firewall allowlist to pass to their SOC.

lee: Options: VPC peering (preserves client src IP), PrivateLink (interface endpoints, no route changes), or hub proxy (central NAT/NLB with static EIPs). Tradeoffs: peering = simpler app logs; PrivateLink = smaller blast radius; proxy = easiest for TLS inspection + central logging.

oscar: If they require original client IP in app logs -> peering or transparent router. PrivateLink + proxy will SNAT unless app uses X-Forwarded-For. Also ask if they do inline TLS inspection or re-encrypt.

infra-bot: Quick SG allowlist snippet: ```
ALLOW tcp 443 to 198.51.100.10/32
ALLOW tcp 443 to 198.51.100.11/32
# Replace with assigned EIPs or ENI IPs for PrivateLink
```

maria: Procurement wants cost direction: peering vs PrivateLink. oscar, can you produce a quick $/GB delta if I send expected monthly GB?

oscar: Yep, send GB and AZ count. I'll return a small table. ETA EOD.

lee: Note re: SD-WAN MTU ~1400: recommend TCP MSS clamp ~1360 on their edge to avoid fragmentation across tunnels.

maria: Action items: oscar -> cost delta; lee -> one-pager with MSS commands + SG/NACL checklist; maria -> invite customer neteng + legal for retention question. Drop any pre-call Qs here and I'll include in invite.
